text: US stock and bond markets were closed Thursday for Thanksgiving, so the stock funds, yields and the VIX still show Wednesday's closes. Trading resumes Friday with stocks closing early.

Brent settled at $96.57, up $1.96, its third straight gain and about 8% since Monday, after Houthi claims of a strike on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery and reports of mine strikes on tankers near Hormuz.
Spot gold ended Thursday down about 0.6% near $3,566 in thin trading, as markets kept pricing another Fed rate hike in December.
Silver edged up to about $41.42, so the gold/silver ratio fell to about 86 from 87.3.
Tokyo core inflation for November came in at 2.9%, a touch below the 3.0% forecast; the yen softened slightly, with the dollar near 159.35 yen.
The dollar index stayed roughly flat near 103.70 through the holiday.
Bitcoin ended Thursday near $60,840, up about 3% from Wednesday.
